$description: Plina Finance Design System v1.1 — tokens in W3C DTCG format. Derived from docs/brand_guidelines.html (Identity & Visual Guidelines v1.0) and reconciled with DESIGN.md ('The Regulated Terminal'). Machine-readable source of truth: every other artifact in this folder is generated from or must agree with this file.

surface.$description: The three-surface sandwich. A page alternates between exactly these three. Never introduce a fourth content surface.

sheet-white.$description: Primary light surface. Sections: product, principles, lead capture.

document-grey.$description: Alternate light surface. Uncoated-paper feel. Also the fill of inputs and chips. Brand name: Off-White.

deep-petrol.$description: Dark surface and the dominant text colour on light. Brand name: Base Plina.

backdrop.$description: Decor-only backdrop. NOT a fourth content surface. Legal only behind the ambient-blob motif in hero/cover/full-bleed dark panels. Never carries body copy directly, never appears on a light page.

abyss.$description: Darkened Deep Petrol used as the canvas for ambient light blobs.

signal.$description: The single accent of the system. Appears on <=10% of any viewport (The One Voice Rule). Pick the step by the surface it sits on.

500.$description: Action Cyan. The brand cyan. Text/icon use ONLY on deep-petrol or abyss (5.47:1 / 6.79:1). Also used as a fill.

600.$description: Cyan text on sheet-white only (4.94:1). FAILS AA on document-grey (3.89:1) — use signal.700 there.

700.$description: Cyan text that passes AA on BOTH light surfaces: sheet-white 5.99:1, document-grey 4.71:1. Safest cyan ink on light. Prefer this when the surface is not statically known.

support.$description: Secondary hues. Hover and tonal variation on dark surfaces only. Never a second signal.

stellar-mid.$description: Support Blue. Hover of heavy numeric elements on dark (5.29:1 on deep-petrol). FAILS on all light surfaces.

glacier-tint.$description: Detail Mist. Secondary body copy and editorial-title hover on dark (9.32:1 on deep-petrol). FAILS on all light surfaces.

ink.$description: Text colours, resolved per surface. Use these rather than picking a surface colour by hand.

on-light-muted.$description: Secondary copy on light. Do not go below 0.6 alpha for body text.

on-light-faint.$description: Decorative only: rest-state numerals in the numbered-list pattern. Never for readable text.

on-dark.$description: Off-White #e4e4e4 on deep-petrol, 12.25:1. Preferred over pure white for long copy on dark.

on-signal.$description: MANDATORY text colour on an Action Cyan fill (5.47:1). White on cyan is 2.85:1 and is forbidden.

hairline.$description: The only structural separator in the system. 1px. Never a coloured border.

on-dark-tinted.$description: Glacier-tinted hairline for outer frames of dark panels.

state.$description: Functional colours. Deliberately minimal — the system has no decorative status palette.

focus-ring-on-dark.$description: 5.47:1 on deep-petrol. Clears the 3:1 non-text minimum (WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11).

focus-ring-on-light.$description: 5.99:1 on sheet-white, 4.71:1 on document-grey. Action Cyan MUST NOT be used as a focus ring on light: it is only 2.85:1 / 2.24:1 and fails the 3:1 non-text minimum.

danger.$description: 6.54:1 on sheet-white, 5.14:1 on document-grey. Errors only, never decoration.

display.$description: Editorial voice. Logotype, section anchors, titles. Fontshare.

label.$description: Uppercase metadata, eyebrows, button labels. Google Fonts.

mono.$description: Every number that carries meaning. The signature of the system. Google Fonts.

logotype.$description: 'Plina' + a period in signal colour. The period is the mark.

display.$description: Hero H1 and primary section anchors.

headline.$description: Titles inside a section. Always preceded by an eyebrow.

body.$description: The Light-Body Rule: weight 300. Max measure 65-75ch.

eyebrow.$description: Opens every section, in signal colour. Never a display heading alone.

eyebrow-wide.$description: Hero and cover variant. Wider tracking for full-bleed dark panels.

label.$description: Nav items, button labels, chips, footer tags.

data.$description: The Mono-For-Data Rule. Percentages, durations, SEP ids, AUTH flags, hashes, addresses, AUM.

data-micro.$description: Chrome metadata: page markers, section counters, network tags.

radius.$description: Binary by doctrine in product UI: 0 or full. Nothing in between.

none.$description: Cards, tiles, panels, images, tables. Sharp corners are anti-SaaS doctrine.

deck.$description: PRESENTATION ONLY. Slide cards in brand_guidelines.html and pitch decks. Forbidden in product UI.

md.$description: Internal padding of a card or tile.

gutter.$description: Horizontal page gutter. The deck uses a fixed 120px; product UI scales.

measure.$description: Max line length for body copy. Hard cap 75ch.

content-max.$description: Content container. Also the deck slide width.

terminal.$description: ease-out-quart. The ONLY easing in the system. Every transition and animation uses it.

instant.$description: Colour and opacity on small controls.

slow.$description: The signature cyan bar scale-y reveal.

motif.$description: Ambient Light Blobs — the signature visual motif. Organic, diffuse cyan luminosity emerging from darkness: the metaphor for liquidity in continuous motion. STRICTLY décor: dark surfaces only, behind content, never on light surfaces, never behind or inside a content card, never interactive.

primary.$value: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, rgba(14,167,199,0.22) 0%, rgba(14,167,199,0.06) 45%, transparent 70%)

orb.$description: Legacy large glow: a solid signal.500 circle at opacity 0.15 with blur(100px), 500-800px, anchored off-canvas at a panel corner. Max ONE per viewport. Prefer the blob set above.

fractal-glass.$description: Fractal ribbed glass overlay. Cover and full-bleed hero art ONLY — never over readable text at full strength, never on content cards.

elevation.$description: Flat by doctrine. Depth comes from the tonal sandwich and hairlines, never from shadow.

cta.$description: THE SINGLE EXCEPTION. Hover state of the one primary lead-capture CTA per page. Nothing else in the system casts a shadow.
